summary: Urban heat islands: krige point temperatures into a surface, average it per census block and highlight blocks with many people over 65.
notes: With a temperature raster already present, summarize_each would do the averaging; the kriging step is the core and is new.

summary: Transit access: overlay bus-stop service areas with three census-block factors (poverty, density, car access) as transparent layers.
notes: A buffer of stops plus one color_by is possible now; layering three demographic factors with transparency is not.

summary: Burn scars: difference the Normalized Burn Ratio between two years of local imagery and turn the damaged area into polygons.
notes: Band math on supplied imagery, not classification, so not out of scope; vectorising is new.

summary: Groundwater vulnerability: project soils, rasterise drainage and water depth, reclassify and combine them into vulnerable areas.
notes: Polygon-to-raster conversion (rasterize) is new.

summary: Privacy-preserving map of child blood-lead cases: hot-spot analysis and counts in a hexagon tessellation.
notes: Hexagon/quadtree tessellation is new.

summary: Elk GPS tracks: home range by convex hull, kernel density and DBSCAN clusters.
Land subsidence and flooding: raster calculation of future flood areas, intersect with buildings, estimate damage.
Fire station coverage gaps: buffer the stations and find the part of the district with no coverage.
notes: The buffer itself is the certified buffer action; the gap (district minus buffers) needs erase.

summary: Deforestation rate: share of deforested area inside a 5.5 km road buffer in Rondônia.
notes: Deforestation is a polygon layer; clipping it to the merged buffer and measuring is needed. If it were a raster, summarize_here would answer it now.

summary: Proposed roads: 5.5 km buffer around planned roads overlaid on deforestation, protected forest and the state boundary.
notes: Buffer and display are possible now; the impact (buffer outside existing road zones / clipped to forest) needs an overlay.

summary: Coral and sponge sites: slope and aspect from bathymetry, sampled at each site, mean per species.
Terrain ruggedness from elevation for mountain-lion habitat.
notes: Focal (neighbourhood) statistics are new.

summary: South Atlantic: vertical temperature–salinity profile from NetCDF within a lat/lon/depth window.
notes: Reading multidimensional NetCDF variables is new.

summary: 240 years of North American temperature: count five-year spells above 280 K.
Ionosphere Total Electron Content from NetCDF as a filled contour map.
notes: Reading multidimensional NetCDF variables is new.

summary: Quadratic trend fit of North American temperature time series.
Map the fatal car crashes of 2016 over the city's districts.
notes: The original also reprojects for plotting; LayeredMap displays in its own projection.

cases.request: Show only the 2016 car crashes in which someone was killed.
只显示2016年有人死亡的车祸

summary: Street trees: share of trees with no species recorded in each region, shown as a quadtree map.
notes: Filtering trees with empty species and counting them per neighbourhood is possible now; the percentage needs a field calculation and the quadtree cells are new. Hexagon/quadtree tessellation is new.

summary: Water quality: interpolate point samples into a surface.
notes: The task leaves the method open; IDW (rasterops::idw) satisfies it, kriging would be new.

summary: Random-forest prospectivity map for tin-tungsten deposits in Tasmania.

cases.request: Train a random forest on the mineral occurrences and evidence rasters and map the probability of new deposits.

summary: Reclassify land cover and protected status to a common suitability scale.
Weighted cost surface from ruggedness, road distance, land cover and protected status.
Open space for flood insurance: predominant land cover and open-space area of each parcel.
notes: summarize_each gives each parcel's land-cover shares (and the largest class); converting a share to m² is a field calculation the card does not do.

cases.request: What share of each parcel is covered by each land cover class?

summary: De-identify child records by rounding coordinates to two decimals and rebuilding the points.
COVID-19 risk profiles in Hong Kong: similarity search per risk, joins, multivariate clustering.
notes: Multivariate clustering here is attribute clustering of constituencies; point_clustering is the nearest op.

summary: Groundwater vulnerability from rasterised drainage and water depth.
notes: Polygon-to-raster conversion (rasterize) is new.

summary: High-risk undeveloped zones from vulnerability and land-cover rasters.
Random-forest model of origin–destination flows from socio-economic attributes.

cases.request: Predict the flows between neighbourhoods with a random forest trained on their socio-economic data.

summary: Tsunami travel time over bathymetry from an origin point.
Commuter bike routes: demand hot spots, weighted suitability of streets, network routing.
Aggregation scales of geographical flows with the L-function.
notes: Point-pattern statistics; hot_spots is the nearest op.

summary: Optimal corridors between mountain-lion habitats over a weighted cost surface.
notes: Least-cost corridors need a cost-distance surface (new). Focal (neighbourhood) statistics are new.

summary: Flood damage to buildings in 2050: flood depth from elevation and sea level, depth per building, damage.
notes: Once a depth raster exists, summarize_each gives depth per building now.

summary: Rural access to all-season roads in Japan: share of rural population within 2 km of those roads.
notes: Buffer of roads and a population sum in the buffer are possible now; restricting to rural areas and the percentage are not.

summary: Landslide potential after a wildfire: burn severity (NBR change), slope, land cover remapped and combined.
Hail damage to cornfields: SAVI change between two images, mean loss per field.
notes: Once the loss raster exists, summarize_each gives the mean per field now.

summary: Heat sentiment from tweets: score weather tweets with a vocabulary, assign them to counties, mean per county.
notes: Scoring tweet text is text processing, not a map action; if the tweets carried a score field, count_in with stat mean would do the spatial part.

cases.request: Score these tweets for heat sentiment using my word list and average the scores in each county.

summary: Campus travel times from one building to all others over an OpenStreetMap street graph.
notes: The task downloads the OSM graph; with a local street layer this would be a one-to-many network cost (od_matrix, new).

cases.request: Download the campus street network from OpenStreetMap and compute driving times from the geography building to every other building.

summary: Geographically weighted regression of bachelor's degree rate in Georgia counties.
Change in malaria prevalence 2000–2015: raster difference with a diverging classification.
Campsite data quality: joins, relates and relationship classes between campsites and campgrounds.
Airbnb prices in Berlin: median price per neighbourhood, then local Moran's I.
notes: The median price per neighbourhood is count_in with stat median today; the autocorrelation is the core and is new.

summary: Elk home ranges: convex hull, kernel density and DBSCAN outputs saved to a geodatabase.
Fire station coverage: buffers, the most compromised areas and the no-service area saved.
Terrain ruggedness by 3×3 focal statistics, rescaled into a cost layer.
notes: Focal (neighbourhood) statistics are new.

summary: Peak-time crash hot spots on roads: select, snap to roads, spatial join, crash rate, Getis-Ord Gi*.
Impervious surface area of each land parcel (tabulate area and join).
notes: summarize_each on a categorical raster gives each parcel's impervious share; area in m² needs a field calculation.

cases.request: How much of each parcel is impervious surface?
每个地块的不透水面占多少？

summary: Loan interest rates: tracts with ≥ 30 loans, hot spots, geographically weighted regression.
Homelessness in North Dakota: join a table to US states by abbreviation and map it.
Seagrass habitat prediction: dissolve, random points, kriging of ocean variables, MaxEnt presence-only model.
notes: Uses dissolve, random points and kriging on the way, but the deliverable is a predictive model.

cases.request: Predict where seagrass could grow along the US coast with a presence-only model.
